comments.author: Nina
comments.body: Where is the best place to sell Amber!? Can amber be good for Nanban exchange in EA!?

comments.author: AliBayan
comments.body:
Seems the best place for "normal" selling is SEA and Oceania, though India and South America West are decent too.
I haven't tried nanban-ing it, but it looks good in those tables here, especially to trade in China.

comments.author: Glow
comments.body: Doing pretty good in EA, Nagasaki is almost always low on gems

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
Can also be bought in Bremen during the 15th century periods 1 through 3.

By the way, these are excellent to bring for the nanban trade in China and Japan (not so much for Korea and Taiwan). However the cost can be a tad high, and you can only buy a limited quantity of these at a time; at R20 Jewellry trading I was able to purchase only 95-100...
